name: shiny-react-modules
description: Shiny module namespace example using shiny-react

scripts.build: concurrently -c auto "npm run build-app" "npm run build-standard" "tsc --noEmit"
scripts.build-app: concurrently -c auto "npm run build-app-r" "npm run build-app-py"
scripts.build-standard: concurrently -c auto "npm run build-standard-r" "npm run build-standard-py"
scripts.dev: concurrently -c auto "npm run watch-app" "npm run shinyapp"
scripts.dev-r: concurrently -c auto "npm run watch-app-r" "npm run shinyapp-r"
scripts.dev-py: concurrently -c auto "npm run watch-app-py" "npm run shinyapp-py"
scripts.dev-standard: concurrently -c auto "npm run watch-standard" "npm run shinyapp-standard"
scripts.dev-standard-r: concurrently -c auto "npm run watch-standard-r" "npm run shinyapp-standard-r"
scripts.dev-standard-py: concurrently -c auto "npm run watch-standard-py" "npm run shinyapp-standard-py"
scripts.watch-app: concurrently -c auto "npm run watch-app-r" "npm run watch-app-py" "tsc --noEmit --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.watch-standard: concurrently -c auto "npm run watch-standard-r" "npm run watch-standard-py"
scripts.shinyapp: concurrently -c auto "npm run shinyapp-r" "npm run shinyapp-py"
scripts.shinyapp-standard: concurrently -c auto "npm run shinyapp-standard-r" "npm run shinyapp-standard-py"

author: Winston Chang
